name: Number C6: Chronomaly Chaos Atlandis
effectText:
3 Level 7 monsters
If you activate either of this card's effects, your opponent takes no further damage this turn (this is not an effect). Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 1000 ATK. If this card has "Number 6: Chronomaly Atlandis" as material: You can detach 3 materials from this card, and send all face-up "Number" Monster Cards you control equipped to this card by its effect to the GY (min. 1); make your opponent's LP 100.
